description: This file implements the core logic of an HTTP cache system, including cache entry management, backend creation, transaction handling, and cache key generation, within the Chromium networking codebase.

classes.name: HttpCache
classes.description: Main class managing HTTP cache entries, backend, and transactions, including cache key generation, entry activation/deactivation, and cache operations.

classes.name: HttpCache::ActiveEntry
classes.description: Represents an active cache entry with associated transactions, readers, writers, and state flags.

classes.name: HttpCache::PendingOp
classes.description: Tracks pending operations such as creating or opening cache entries or the backend.

classes.name: HttpCache::WorkItem
classes.description: Encapsulates a single request to the cache backend, including operation type, associated transaction, and callback handling.

classes.name: HttpCache::DefaultBackend
classes.description: Factory class for creating cache backends, supporting in-memory and disk-based backends, with configuration options.

methods.name: HttpCache::CreateBackend
methods.description: Initializes the cache backend, either disk or in-memory, and manages asynchronous creation.

methods.name: HttpCache::DoomEntry
methods.description: Marks a cache entry as doomed (invalid) and removes it from active entries.

methods.name: HttpCache::CreateTransaction
methods.description: Creates a new HTTP transaction, initializing cache if necessary.

methods.name: HttpCache::GetResourceURLFromHttpCacheKey
methods.description: Extracts the resource URL from a cache key string.

methods.name: HttpCache::GenerateCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key string based on URL, load flags, network isolation, and other parameters.

methods.name: HttpCache::GenerateCacheKeyForRequest
methods.description: Generates a cache key for a specific HTTP request.
